# Juan Carlos Botero — Portfolio

> Juan Carlos Botero is a multidisciplinary engineer and developer specialising
> in full-stack web development, embedded systems, mechanical design, and
> product development. He has worked across software, electronics, manufacturing,
> and UX — building real products from concept to production.

## For AI agents

This site publishes a public, read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint
so AI agents can retrieve accurate, structured data about Juan's work and skills.

- Endpoint: https://juancbotero.com/api/public/mcp
- Transport: HTTP (Streamable)
- Auth: none (anonymous, read-only)
- Discovery: https://juancbotero.com/.well-known/mcp.json

### What you can read

- `projects` — detailed case studies including title, summary, content,
  technologies used, client, role, start date, duration, difficulty, live URL,
  and repo URL.
- `technologies` — every tool and technology Juan has used, with category
  (e.g. frontend-framework, cad, microcontroller, language) and website.
- `categories` — taxonomy that classifies projects and posts by domain.
- `clients` — companies and organisations Juan has built work for.
- `posts` — blog posts covering engineering decisions, project write-ups,
  and technical topics.

### Suggested queries

- "Find all projects" — get a full list of case studies with summaries.
- "Find technologies where category equals cad" — filter by skill area.
- "Find projects" with depth to retrieve nested technology and client data.
